_meta.purpose: Ground-truth university IDENTITY registry, keyed by canonical domain. Supplies main_info identity fields (name, abbreviation, city, type, aliases, established_year, accreditation_body) deterministically so the LLM is never asked to guess them. Rankings are intentionally not part of this pipeline; if added later they belong in a separate, separately-verified file.
